task: Turn the Phase 25 SDK compatibility baseline into strict G5-03 ABI-v10 acceptance evidence.
observation: The existing full SDK smoke runner returns success when a package or engine reports a documented LIMITATION, and its source-free checks still describe ABI-v9. That output cannot prove the frozen all-packages ABI-v10 build gate.
impact: A green compatibility smoke run could otherwise be mistaken for clean G5-03 acceptance; the gate needed a separate exact package/profile artifact check.
evidence: MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 python3 tests/phase25/integration/test_sdk_matrix.py: G5 SDK ABI-v10 matrix: 34/34 builds, 17 packages, 2 profiles

resolution.summary: The smoke runner remains a permissive Phase 24 baseline. The separate strict G5 SDK matrix passed all 17 primary SDK packages in debug and release under ABI-v10 and verified emitted schema/native ABI 10 interfaces; the combined integration head still requires rerun.
